items.html: However, there is only one separated Mocha inside that Galgalta, called Hochma de AA. Since this Hochma and that Mocha too, contain Behinat three Mochin, as we will explain later, yet all three are but Behinat Hochma itself.Thus, it turns out that in that Reisha de AA there was only one Galgalta, which is Keter de AA, and inside it, one Mocha which is Hochma de AA. However, Bina de AA could not stand there in Behinat Reisha.
